text: Our tutorial Building Production LLM Agents: An Evaluation-Driven Playbook was accepted to the CIKM 2026 tutorials track.
Gave a talk at AI Engineer with Shreya Rajpal, SimulationMaxxing: How we ship agents 20× faster.
Our AI Core team hosted the first NuSession in Silicon Valley, on scaling agentic AI systems to 135M users.
Building Customer Support Agents at 100M-User Scale: An Evaluation-Driven Framework was accepted to KDD 2026.
Presented Effective Quantization of Muon Optimizer States at the ICLR 2026 SPOT workshop, scaling 8-bit Muon to 2.7B parameters.
My QCon AI New York talk Building AI Agents for 127 Million Customers is now on Nubank's YouTube channel.
AlphaPO: Reward Shape Matters for LLM Alignment and On the Robustness of Reward Models both appeared at ICML 2025.
Joined Nubank to lead research on LLM training and agents.
